gitCommit.subject: test(SHOP-2): match the cart heading's exact name in the browser test
gitCommit.body:
test(SHOP-2): match the cart heading's exact name in the browser test

Without exact: true, Playwright compares the accessible name as a
case-insensitive substring: "cart (3)" or "Cart (3) items" passed the
browser test, while the ticket asks for "Cart (3)". The unit test,
with Testing Library, already compares the whole name.
